example.title: Way Side Stock Farm, house, 64480 718 Rd

brief: Showy two-storey stock farmer's house: a big hipped white clapboard block with hipped dormers and a tall brick chimney, fronted by a wraparound one-storey porch whose solid clapboard walls are pierced by broad round arches and round oculus openings, with a spindled balustrade running along the porch roof as a second-floor deck. A projecting bay in the middle of the porch is flanked by two little pointed cedar-shingle turret caps. Grey asphalt roofs, lattice skirting, brick piers; windbreak cedars and fields around, a gravel drive sweeping past.
